decisions.story_title: Citizen Lab finds Paragon Graphite spyware used in zero-click attacks on two journalists
decisions.reason: Primary forensic research from Citizen Lab naming the Graphite spyware, the vendor (Paragon), and the zero-click iPhone attack chain against two journalists. Substantive surveillance/mercenary-spyware event worth its own story.

Single vendor-blog advisory (Stackurity) for Rucio CVE-2026-100397 unauthenticated admin impersonation. Unverified lead with no corroborating primary source or feed coverage, and no matching existing story to attach to; too thin to mint.

Low-signal aggregator repost (radar.offseq.com) of CVE-2026-129454, an authenticated low-priv authorization bypass in Zr.Admin.NET. No exploitation, no corroboration, no matching candidate story; not worth a dedicated story.

phpwarden advisory repost for CVE-2012-1823, a PHP-CGI RCE fixed in 2012. 'Exploited in the wild' here refers to historical abuse of long-patched software, not a current event; rediscovery of an ancient CVE with no new development.
phpwarden advisory repost for CVE-2009-1151, a phpMyAdmin config-injection RCE fixed in 2009. Stale rediscovery of an ancient patched CVE with no current development.

phpwarden advisory repost for CVE-2020-12641, a Roundcube RCE fixed in 2020. The existing Roundcube story (roundcube-webmail-cve-2025-68461-xss-exploited-in-the-wild) covers a different, current CVE; this is a stale rediscovery of a years-old flaw.
PyPI blog post announcing a redesigned web UI with a security/provenance tab. Product feature announcement, not a vulnerability or security event; not coverage-worthy.
Cultural/human-interest piece about a sold-out 100-yen paper password notebook in Japan. Not a security event, advisory, or breach.
Be Connected (Australian government) consumer how-to on making video calls. Generic explainer/consumer tips, no security substance.
Art/education project turning famous malware (ILOVEYOU, Flame, Gh0st RAT) into cartoon 'Malmons'. Not a security event or actionable reporting.
